review: Independent read-only production review by public-test author, not provider author.
findings: Recovery: bothvalid Aahead chooses B mandatory; equalcounter mismatch, Bahead, crossedbinding/generation/session reject; counter gaps allowed and checked maximum+1.

Malformed checksum-valid records reject rather than become fallback candidates; missing selected files or malformed/missing selector fail closed. CRC-invalid128B record alone can use the surviving fixed witness; B length is structurally exactly128B.
Sole surviving witness is protected until counterpart repair sync succeeds; Native recovery validates complete mandatory prefix before publication/repair.
Fresh initialization exposes no manifest until compound publication succeeds; selector only follows synced witnesses. Leaf+parent namespace syncs precede successful fresh store creation/publication.

Inactive parity generation WAL+A and B are synchronized and directory synchronized before selector write/sync/rename/directory sync; selected generation switches before old files cleanup. No historical generation fallback.
Healthy steady publication writes A, syncs WAL, writes B, syncs B; no ordinary file create, truncate, rename or directory sync. Repair/init/reclaim have additional cold path work.

Native creation/recovery/barrier invoke combined seam. Default implementation retains prior sync_log then publish_manifest order for legacy FileLogIo/StripedJournal. BenchJournal forwards combined operation directly. Deliberate FileLogIo observer remains concrete, so cannot accidentally add third sync to WitnessLogIo.
File creation follows existing legacy OpenOptions and caller umask/parent directory permissions; no new permission widening or chmod policy.
confidence: No concrete blocker found by invariant/call-order/source inspection combined with15 passed public realfile tests. Finite test/model evidence, not a complete proof or physical device power-loss qualification.
limitations: CRC is accidental-damage detection, not protection against adversarial checksum-forged coherent metadata or CRC collisions.
Exclusive binding assumes no concurrent external file mutation; live prefix bytes are not re-read on every barrier, as with legacy provider. Offline damage is checked during recovery.
Primitive injected errors/constructed durable byte images are not actual power cuts or exhaustive filesystem/device persistence order experiments.
Extra syncs on repair/initialization/reclamation and caller wrappers that fail to forward combined operation must remain separately disclosed.
Cross-filesystem gains and fullP9 remain open; FileLogIo stays default.
